title: Rava Kesari
description: A bright saffron-scented South Indian sooji sweet cooked in ghee with cashews and raisins.
steps: Warm the water and dissolve the saffron in it.
Heat 1 tbsp of the ghee and fry the cashews and raisins until golden; set aside.
Add 2 tbsp more ghee and roast the sooji on low heat until it smells nutty and turns slightly pink.
Pour in the saffron water carefully and stir continuously to avoid lumps; cook until the sooji absorbs it.
Add the sugar and cardamom; the mixture will loosen, then cook until thick and glossy.
Stir in the remaining ghee and the fried nuts and serve warm.
